text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Dosukoi! Dosukoi!
Ehehe, my special training with Bono is really paying off!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Hm? Who's that over there...?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Just a bit further to the school building.
All right, let's do this.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
That's an incredible amount of carrots! And all kinds of other vegetables, too!
Is Miracle-senpai pushing this cart all by herself?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
The cafeteria staff looked overwhelmed.
Don't worry, I'll carry it all!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I know! Then let me push!
I'll power-drive it all the way to the cafeteria!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Thrusting forward?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for helping me.
Hehe... you're pretty good at slap thrusts, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
You're amazing, always helping someone out.
Let me repay the favor someday, hero.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
A hero!? Was I... really a proper hero!?
...Heheh, yay!!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Hello.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Zephyr-senpai! Is there anything you need help with
either!? Like something that needs pushing?!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Who, me...?
No, not particularly—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Mmmh... But I wanna do way more thrusts!
Dosukoi, dosukoi!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Biko-san, could you repeat that one more time...?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Hm? Dosukoi! Dosukoi!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
This is... a wind I've never encountered before.
Within the hot gale lies a hidden frost.
It carries a strength akin to an early summer tempest—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I want to feel this wind even more...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Looks like you took a liking to the breeze
from my sumo thrusts, huh?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, is that so!?
Then I'll push even more air!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Dosukoi Cannon! Dosukoi Slash!
Pegasus Dosukoi Hurricane! Whaaaaa!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: The wind created by a passion for sports... Hehe, it feels so refreshing, completely different from the wind when running.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Dosukoi, dosukoi!
Miracle-senpai, let's do a combo move here!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Huh... M-Me too?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...D-Dosukoi!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
This feels... like a delicate night breeze.
A gentle wind full of consideration, just like you.
I want to feel it forever...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After this, with gratitude and wishing everyone could stir up
an even better breeze, Yamanin Zephyr treated everyone
to chanko nabe—
